unitTitle: B1 · Explain needs, preferences and recommendations
title: Checkpoint
subtitle: B1 · Unit 5: B1 · Explain needs, preferences and recommendations

steps.prompt: Which pattern expresses a need with a different subject?
options: Il faut que la salle sera accessible.
Il faut que la salle soit accessible.
Il faut la salle être accessible.
Il faut la salle est accessible.
steps.explain: Il faut que introduces the subjunctive in this pattern.

steps.prompt: When is the infinitive normally used?
options: Only in a past story
After every que
When the subject stays the same
After every expression of emotion
steps.explain: The infinitive is normal when the same person does both actions.

options: A result
A preference
A deadline
A barrier
steps.explain: An obstacle is a barrier or difficulty.

options: Je souhaite que les consignes soient claires.
Je souhaite que les consignes seront claires.
Je souhaite les consignes claires que.
Je souhaite les consignes sont claires.
steps.explain: This wish has a different subject and uses the subjunctive.

options: An unrelated complaint
A specific need and a practical example
A copied model
A guaranteed promise
steps.explain: Specific feedback helps the group decide what to change.
